data.standardized_narrative: The report shows gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 (the prior-year comparative column) of GBP 90.652m. The document does not present an explicitly identifiable gross prior-year movement (re-estimation of years prior to 2015) in a clearly labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' note that could be unambiguously extracted. The syndicate discloses catastrophe exposures (eg. Los Angeles earthquake, Florida windstorm, US North East windstorm, Japan earthquake) and states total gross premiums written of c.GBP 474.3m for 2015. Because a definitive gross prior-year movement figure could not be located in the readable pages, prior-year development is reported as null and the narrative is based on available balance sheet and premium disclosures.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: scanned pages are rotated and partially low resolution. The gross 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative value was read from the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) where the 2014 column showed GBP 90,652 (000). No unambiguous GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or a GROSS prior-year development figure was clearly legible in the notes; narrative mentions of 'net' releases or aggregate P&L prior-year claims were avoided per instructions. A catastrophe exposure table and total gross premiums (c.GBP 474.3m) were readable. Because no clear gross prior-year movement note or triangle could be confidently extracted, prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. If a higher-resolution original PDF is provided, a more precise extraction (including prior year movement and the claims development triangle) is likely possible.
